intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a potential buffer overflow vulnerability by adding a bounds check on the SCTP chunk length during cookie unpacking.
intent_record.what: Added logic to cast the cookie payload to an SCTP chunk header and validate that the chunk's length does not exceed the remaining buffer size.
intent_record.how: Prevents out-of-bounds memory reads by ensuring the inner chunk length fits within the available packet data before further processing, redirecting to error handling if invalid.
